name: sentinel
title: SENTINEL — Agent-Level Transaction Safety Oracle
description: Pre-execution safety verdict for autonomous AI agents. Analyzes a pending on-chain transaction (contract security, simulation, MEV/sandwich exposure) and returns SAFE / UNSAFE / UNKNOWN with a signed receipt and a standardized SENTINEL Score (AAA-D). Pay-per-call $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base mainnet. Pure M2M — no human in the loop.

tools.name: sentinel_guard
tools.description: Evaluate a transaction before signing. Returns SAFE/UNSAFE/UNKNOWN verdict, SENTINEL Score (0-100) + grade (AAA-D), risk flags and signed receipt.
